# GameWheelClub

> Free, zero-cookie, client-side decision tools and random choice generators. Built for instant decision-making, raffles, classrooms, games, and productivity.

## Core Capabilities

- **Random Decision Wheel**: Spin customizable wheels for instant decision making (`/decision-wheel`).
- **Wheel of Names**: Draw random names for giveaways, classroom participation, and raffles (`/wheel-of-names`).
- **Yes/No Wheel**: Fast binary decision wheel for simple choices (`/yes-no-wheel`).
- **Random Number Generator**: Generate custom range random integers with optional unique mode (`/random-number-generator`).
- **Flip a Coin**: 3D animated coin flipper for Heads or Tails (`/flip-a-coin`).
- **Dice Roller**: Roll 1 to 3 animated 6-sided dice with total score calculation (`/dice-roller`).
- **Countdown Timer**: Simple visual timer with alarm sounds (`/timer`).

## URL Query Parameter API (State Sharing)

GameWheelClub supports URL-encoded wheel options without any server storage.
To pre-populate options on any wheel page, use the base64-encoded `d` query parameter:

- **Format**: `https://gamewheelclub.com/?d=<base64_json_array>`
- **Example**: `https://gamewheelclub.com/?d=WyJZZXMiLCJObyIsIk1heWJlIl0=` (Encodes `["Yes","No","Maybe"]`)

## Technical Specifications

- **Privacy Model**: 100% Client-side JavaScript. Zero cookies, zero external server tracking.
- **Randomness**: Secure PRNG (`Math.random` / `crypto.getRandomValues`).
- **Localization**: Supports 28 languages (English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Chinese, Arabic, Portuguese, Russian, Korean, Hindi, etc.).
- **Accessibility**: Full WCAG 2.1 AA compliance, high contrast, screen reader ARIA labels, and agent-queryable DOM IDs (`#spin-button`, `#option-input`, `#add-option-btn`).
